data so the two implementations walk identical state. Three more (14-16) ask
the questions v4's suite does not: the cross-app ledger row, a pass with
nothing to collapse, and a roll whose storageKey names no blob.
A roll seeds a `files` row PLUS its vault file/blob/link/chunk, exactly as
v4's `seedRoll` does. `noBlob: true` seeds the files row alone.
